# SafeLogger

abstract class [SafeLogger](index.html) : [Logger](../-logger/index.html)

An abstract base class for [Logger](../-logger/index.html) implementations that safely evaluates the log message lambda. If the lambda throws an exception, it is caught and logged without crashing the application.
